title: use zeroize::Zeroize as _ inside fn body in config validation
description: smtp/config.rs:576 and reader/config.rs:782 both write 'use zeroize::Zeroize as _;' inside the validate() function body, just to call seed_bytes.zeroize(). Trait imports inside function bodies compile but are unusual in idiomatic Rust — they hide the dependency from the module-level use block, making it harder to see what traits a module depends on. The import should be at the module top-level (or crate level) alongside other use statements. Maintainers scanning the file for dependencies miss it. Two locations: smtp/config.rs line 576 and reader/config.rs line 782.
